card.name: Linking words before an expected outcome
card.fires_on: Small connecting words such as 'in' after 'result', 'to' after 'return', and 'based' after 'is', where a noun phrase or outcome comes next. Also fires on some adverbs and quantity words like 'infinitely' and 'little' in technical or drug-label prose.

modes.label: Result in
modes.description: The word 'in' right after 'result' or 'resulted', before an effect such as elevated levels or hypotension.
modes.example: which may result<< in>> hypoglycemia, or hyper

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Prepositions or participles such as 'to' or 'based' in technical engineering text.
modes.example: Another kind of novel random-number generator is<< based>> on chaotic lasers.

modes.label: Degree or quantity words
modes.description: Adverbs or quantifiers like 'infinitely' or 'little' before an adjective or noun.
modes.example: There is<< little>> potential for drug interactions with ziprasid

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that lead into the next phrase, especially 'in' after 'result'.
